# Asechka · Soft Orbit artwork

Twelve original raster illustrations generated using the built-in imagegen tool. Full production prompts are saved in `prompts.json`. Eleven illustrations retain transparent backgrounds; `widget-orbit.png` is an opaque low-contrast widget background. Originals are preserved without cropping, recoloring, or tracing.

The same PNG files are packaged locally in Android and iPhone. Android uses sampled decoding and a bounded bitmap cache. Interactive controls keep native accessibility labels and native press/selection feedback. Photo content and ten existing quote backgrounds are retained.

The letter envelope replaces the standalone heart at the top of incoming messages. The other images appear throughout main navigation, Home shortcuts, sending hearts, saved moments, composers, and widgets.
